title: 架台付きの都市養蜂箱
description: 公共菜園や屋上養蜂エリアの情景用に作成した、架台付きの積層式養蜂箱。3段の木箱、角の継ぎ目、前後の持ち手、張り出した金属蓋、巣門の実際の隙間、着地板と脚部を造形しています。蜂・蜂蜜・巣脾・内部の巣枠・養蜂道具は含みません。養蜂手順や生態・動物の健康、耐候性の保証を示すものではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.605 × 1.102 × 0.880 m、12,100三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A stand-mounted stacked hive for community-garden and rooftop-apiary scenery, with three timber box courses, corner-joint details, front/rear lifting handles, an overhanging metal lid, a genuinely open entrance gap, a landing board and braced legs. Bees, honey, comb, internal frames and beekeeping tools are omitted. It is not beekeeping guidance and makes no ecological, animal-health or weather-resistance claim. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.605 × 1.102 × 0.880 m; 12,100 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
